styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium tech e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep teal studio background #2E5666, deep teal-navy shadow tone #173845, clean light neutral #F4F7F8 for infographic and variant screens, white #FFFFFF for text and info cards with charcoal #2D2D2D card text, and one coral-red accent #E2543E reserved for camera-protection callouts only; cool studio lighting with a soft top-back rim and controlled glossy floor reflections on teal screens, even high-key light on light screens; modern geometric sans-serif type, bold white headlines on teal and charcoal text on light cards; consistent rounded rectangular info cards and thin-line check icons; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
